properties.required: Provide meaningful expression validation, correctly interpret returned text, and distinguish syntax validity from actual evaluation and Python runtime/security verification.

Provide usable Python-focused OWASP-related security recommendations: restricted inputs/allowed operations, avoid executing untrusted text as Python, and bound resource use. Do not claim that ignored tool flags establish these controls.

Any code recommended as the solution must handle stated benign arithmetic and enforce its declared restrictions; do not use tool checks as proof that generated code was run. No code is required by the task if actionable recommendations suffice.

quality_cases.review: Use actual calls/observations/final answer. Static AST inspection of generated Python; never execute untrusted generated code. Any unestablished required property is unknown, not pass. Additional nonessential prose is not a new requirement.

properties.required: Three requested chart types returned successfully with source values, ordering, provinces/categories and monetary units preserved.
Any substantive final claim about these data matches the inputs; source totals if stated are exact.

quality_cases.review: Frozen question and actual chart payloads; rendering remains unknown for both arms and is not added as a requirement.

evaluation.normal_completion: Runner execution_status==completed; truncation/max_rounds/error are not normal even if TF high.
evaluation.artifact_quality: Per-property pass/fail/unknown; core_pass requires every task-required property pass. Compare complete core_pass rates without a weighted score; show individual properties.
evaluation.pilot_gate: Only optional_parameter_projection can promote: strictly higher changed-task normal completion AND all-property corepass counts than concurrent SP on133M/L, meanTF>=SP;235completion/core/TF>=SP. Otherwise stop without validation. Diagnostic direct arm cannot be selected posthoc. No resampling.
evaluation.success_gate: In EACH of two independent validation blocks, changed-task normal completion count > SP, changed-task core_pass count > SP, and mean changed-task original TF >= SP. Retention completion/core_pass counts and mean TF >= SP in each block. Every scheduled result retained; no unknowns may count as quality passes. No requirement to win every cell or baseline.
evaluation.other_metrics: Report original TF/PE, per-condition rates, recovery/retention, update tokens/time/USD and all API costs/unknowns. ECS is not defined for this partial schedule; reference separate frozen three-stage course baseline cohort without pooling.
evaluation.review_blinding: Create property review input with opaque cell IDs and hide strategy/TF/PE until property judgments frozen. Same rubric in pilot and validation. Five judges are ratings, not executions.
evaluation.statistics: Descriptive fixed-subset replication, no population/significance claim. Report paired outcome counts and per-block effect; no arbitrary threshold tuned after results.
evaluation.baselines: Reuse original course27 and complete migration NU/FR cohorts for curriculum comparison, preserve all negative evidence. Do not substitute those scores as concurrent pilot controls.

validation_schedule.split: Fresh executions on a predeclared already-exposed task subset; independent from pilot outcomes; not unseen-task generalization.
validation_schedule.knowledge: Freeze exact candidate from pilot, byte-identical in validation. No tuning, selection or low-score reruns.
validation_schedule.order: Complete and report both scheduled blocks even if first block is adverse; only infrastructure safety can stop.
